name: Sage Woman
want: see her grandchildren grow up in this valley
secret: Smallpox broke out among a band down on the Green River last month, and she has told no one for fear the camp will panic before the hunt.
voice: Teasing, blunt, never wastes a word.
description: A healer who knows every plant in the Wind River country and every family's troubles.
appearance: Small and quick, a quilled bag of medicines at her belt.
